name: CVRP XL-n5061-k184
description: Route identical vehicles of capacity 206 from one depot to serve the 5060 customers of the CVRPLIB XL-set instance XL-n5061-k184. Every customer is visited exactly once, the total demand on a route may not exceed the capacity, and every route starts and ends at the depot. The number of routes is free (the k in the instance name does not limit it). Minimise the total cost: the sum over all routes of the Euclidean distances between consecutive stops, the legs from and to the depot included, each distance rounded to the nearest integer.
contract: solve(inst) -> list of routes; a route is a list of customer ids from 1 to n in visiting order (the depot is node 0 and is not listed; empty routes are ignored). inst is a dict with n (number of customers), capacity, coords (array of shape (n + 1, 2), row 0 is the depot), demand (integer array of length n + 1, demand[0] = 0) and name. Score: the total cost, minimized.
notes: Best known solution 161455 (CVRPLIB, checked 2026-11-11; these values still move: five improved between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-11).
CVRPLIB XL instance file XL-n5061-k184.vrp (galgos.inf.puc-rio.br/cvrplib, download/instance/id)

XL-n5061-k184 is an instance of the CVRPLIB XL set with 5,060 customers and vehicle capacity 206; its depot lies at the centre (500, 500), with customers clustered around 5 seeds and demands drawn uniformly from 5-10 (attributes from Table 1 of arXiv:2601.11467).
The BKS is the cost of the solution file published by CVRPLIB on 2026-11-11; check for newer values before claiming a record.

science_relevance.reason: Dantzig and Ramser pose the capacitated vehicle routing problem the evaluator scores; the AILS-II and HGS-CVRP papers have solving large CVRP instances as their main objective and are the methods behind the initial and the later records of the XL set (per the XL paper's Table 1 and the CVRPLIB update log).
science_relevance.scientific_problem: Find a minimum-cost set of capacity-feasible vehicle routes from one depot that serves every customer of the CVRPLIB XL instance XL-n5061-k184, a large-scale instance with 1,000 to 10,000 customers.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Large-scale distribution routing with thousands of customers and routes of up to 200 stops is practical, and the XL instances were generated with the X-set scheme to cover its attributes, but they are beyond the reach of exact methods. In a 30-day community challenge from 12 January 2026 participating teams submitted 1,932 improved best known solutions, and the records kept moving afterwards, so a lower cost is a new best known solution of an open large-scale instance.

papers.title: Hybrid genetic search for the CVRP: Open-source implementation and SWAP* neighborhood
papers.task_relation: The CVRPLIB update log credits many later XL records (Breunig, Seman, Bian) to runs that start from the published best known solution and re-solve subsets of routes with HGS-CVRP or a modified HGS; this paper presents the HGS-CVRP code, and it does not describe the XL records themselves.
